name: HaulFleetDispatchBoard
tagline: Truck-to-loader dispatch, queues and shift utilisation for open-pit mines – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete haul fleet dispatch app for Canvas and Model-driven apps: KPI dashboard with loader match factor, drag-and-drop dispatch board per loader, fleet list with bulk actions, loader and crusher queues, and per-truck availability and utilisation. Mine dispatch rules (allowed transitions, delay codes, loader capacity) are built in, demo data works the moment it is dropped, and real data connects through Items with dropdown column mappings.
features: Status transition rules, delay/down codes, down reasons
Queue, delay, cycle, fuel and overload alerts
Availability and utilisation per truck, delay code Pareto
Phone layout with bottom view bar
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnStatusChange, OnAction)
Optional direct Dataverse save in model-driven apps
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
